tha-ap148:1.1: anomadassīmunino bodhivedimakāsahaṁ → anomadassissa munino bodhivediṁ akāsahaṁ (sya-all)
tha-ap148:1.4: pāṇikammaṁ akāsahaṁ → pātikammamakāya haṁ (bj) | haṁ → pāṇikammaṁ (bj: machasaṁ); phātikammaṁ (bj: aṭṭhakathā)
tha-ap148:5.2: paripuṇṇe anūnake → paripuṇṇo anūnako (sya-all) | anūnake → paripuṇṇo anūnako (cck: syā.)
